name: Home Persistence
description: Persists selected directories and files in the remote user's home across container rebuilds, using a named volume per dev container.

directories.description: Directories under ~/ to persist, separated by ';' (e.g. '~/.claude;~/.vibe'). Empty persists nothing.

files.description: Files under ~/ to persist, separated by ';' (e.g. '~/.claude.json'). Empty persists nothing.
